package.name: san_perception
package.description:
SAN v1.5 Phase 2-E Turn 11-12 — Perception (Tier 3 rclpy).
NPU-driven object detection + thermal/RGB sensor fusion. Replaces perception/perception_process.py per DCN-2026-002 D-007 (Tier 3 = "rclpy 권장", Python dynamism matches inference workflow, NPU SDK is Python-binding-first, 1-30 Hz rate is fine for rclpy).
Architecture: camera (sensor_msgs/CompressedImage) ─┐ thermal (sensor_msgs/Image) ├─→ PerceptionNode ─→ ~/detections pose (geometry_msgs/PoseStamped) ┘
Internal modules: * fusion.py — pinhole projection, RGB↔thermal alignment (pure NumPy, standalone pytest) * detection.py — NMS, confidence filter, class mapping (pure logic, standalone pytest) * rknn_runner.py — NPU abstraction (Real RKNN + Stub for CI) * perception_node.py — rclpy.Node wrapping the above
